tasks.title: Book Birthday Venue
tasks.description: Book a community hall, clubhouse, or hotel banquet room in Bengaluru suitable for 100 guests. Pay advance and collect booking confirmation.

tasks.title: Book Candid Photographer
tasks.description: Hire a candid photographer for the birthday event. Confirm coverage hours, deliverables (edited photos + short video reel), and advance payment.

tasks.title: Send WhatsApp & Printed Invitations
tasks.description: Design and dispatch digital WhatsApp invitation to all 100 guests. Order printed invitation cards from a local Bangalore printer if needed.

tasks.title: Finalise Caterer & Menu
tasks.description: Book a local caterer for 100 guests. Confirm South-Indian snack menu (sandwiches, pakoras, chaat) and a hot meal for adults. Lock per-plate rate.

tasks.title: Order Custom Birthday Cake
tasks.description: Place a custom theme cake order with a local Bangalore bakery (1–3 kg depending on guest count). Confirm design, flavour, and delivery time.

tasks.title: Purchase Return Gifts / Goody Bags
tasks.description: Buy return gifts for approximately 100 child guests — small goody bags, chocolates, or small toys. Source from local Bangalore wholesale markets.

tasks.title: Arrange Decoration & Sound System
tasks.description: Confirm balloon decoration, theme backdrop, and basic flower arrangement with the decorator. Book a light background music / sound system (NOT a full DJ rig). Do a venue walk-through to verify setup plan.

tasks.title: Day-of Setup, Execution & Vendor Settlement
tasks.description: Arrive early to verify decoration, catering setup, cake delivery, and sound system. Manage guest welcome, cake-cutting ceremony, and photography. Settle final vendor payments and collect receipts.
